evidence.note: Class I: calling twelve bytes a chunk id of type ScriptObjects, and naming the consequence for loader selection, leans on the UE 5.4.4 source layout, which is an external document about vanilla UE and not about this build. What we would see if this were wrong: the twelve-byte pattern absent from every container in the install, or present with a different trailing discriminator byte.
